jina: Terms and conditions of office of President
maudhui: (1) The President shall be paid a salary and such other remuneration, and on retirement shall receive such pension, gratuity or allowance, as Parliament shall determine, and the salary, other remuneration, pension and gratuity shall be a charge on the Consolidated Fund of the Government of the United Republic. (2) The salary and other remuneration payable to the President shall not be reduced while he continues to hold office in accordance with this Constitution.
